text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews and recommend eight public members, including a Chair, for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.

City Council on February 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Hydro Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office starting March 5, 2020 and ending March 5, 2022, continuing to serve until successors are appointed: David McFadden, as Chair George Cooke Tamara Kronis Juliana Lam Michael Nobrega Mary Ellen Richardson Howard Wetston Heather Zordel 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 to the report (February 6, 2020) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.
